items.title: Invisible loading progress bar
items.what: In screenshot 1, the download progress bar is an extremely thin, low-contrast line against the dark background, making progress nearly impossible to discern.
items.why: Players cannot gauge download progress, leading to frustration or belief that the app is frozen during the critical first impression.
items.how: Increase the progress bar height to at least 4px, add a bright accent color matching the gold HUD, and ensure it has sufficient contrast against the dark background.

items.title: Fighter feet clipping through tatami floor
items.what: In screenshots 2, 3, 12, and 13, the fighters' feet appear to sink into or hover slightly above the tatami mat without proper contact shadows or ground intersection.
items.why: Breaks the photorealistic promise and immersion, making the 3D space feel physically incorrect during the core gameplay loop.
items.how: Adjust the Y-position of the fighter rigs to ensure proper ground contact, add dynamic contact shadows beneath the feet, and verify the tatami collision geometry matches the visual floor plane.

items.title: Oversized IPPON text obscuring fighters
items.what: In screenshot 10, the IPPON announcement text is oversized and positioned across the upper torsos of both fighters during the knockout moment, obscuring the visual payoff of the Spinning Back Kick.
items.why: Players miss the climactic visual of the finishing move because the UI covers the action at the most exciting moment.
items.how: Reduce the font size of the IPPON text by 40%, move it to the top HUD area above the fighters, or make it translucent so the fighters remain visible behind it.

items.title: Undersized settings checkboxes
items.what: In screenshot 6, the settings menu checkboxes and their associated text labels are visually small, appearing below the 44x44pt minimum touch target size for mobile interfaces.
items.why: Players struggle to toggle settings like Reduced motion or High contrast, leading to frustration and potential missed accessibility options.
items.how: Increase checkbox size to at least 24x24px with 44x44pt hit areas, increase font size to 16pt minimum, and add more vertical padding between list items.

items.title: Move names floating over combat area
items.what: In screenshots 4 and 11, move names like LUNGE PUNCH and FRONT KICK appear as centered text overlays that float between the fighters during execution, cluttering the combat view.
items.why: The text obstructs the view of the technique animation and breaks immersion during active gameplay.
items.how: Move move-name displays to the top HUD area near the timer, reduce opacity to 70%, or display them as subtle labels near the executing fighter's feet rather than centered on screen.
